One thing to flag: Node's `--test` runner doesn't auto-discover `*.spec.js` by default (it looks for `*.test.js`, `*-test.js`, `test-*.js`, `test.js`, or files under a `test/` dir) — so bare `node --test` finds 0 tests with this naming convention. You'll need to either run with an explicit path/glob, or configure a `test` script in `package.json` like `node --test src/**/*.spec.js` (no `package.json` exists yet in this repo, so nothing is currently wired up).
